Book One · test build An AZTMM game

Nobodyssey

Homer's Odyssey, in eight bits. You are Odysseus, with twelve ships and six hundred men, and you mean to bring every one of them home.

Book One, place by place

Each place on its own, in story order. The whole game opens with no #hash. Saves are kept on this device.

  1. ◆The HorsenightPlay

    Inside the belly with the best of the Greeks, in the dark, waiting for the signal. Keep the men quiet.

  2. ◆Troy at NightnightPlay

    The city is asleep and drunk. Lanterns walk the streets. Get through them to the house of Deiphobus.

  3. ◆The Camp at TroysunsetPlay

    Troy is burned, the captains are scattered, and the kings want everyone in the ring at sunset. Bring them in before the wine does.

  4. ◆TenedosdawnPlay

    One night out from Troy. Twelve ships on the sand, a rock with an altar on it, and a promise you have not made yet.

  5. ◆IsmarosafternoonPlay

    The town is taken. The men are feasting when they should be loading, and the Cicones are gathering inland.

  6. ◆The Lotus ShorenoonPlay

    Three men went inland to see who lived here. The sun has not moved since you landed, and nobody has come back.

  7. ◆Goat IslandafternoonPlay

    Wild goats and no people. Across the water, smoke, and the sound of sheep.

  8. ◆The Cyclops' CaveeveningPlay

    A big cave full of cheeses and lambs. The owner is not home yet.

  • KeyboardArrows walk. Z talks and uses. Q or Tab asks Where now? P pauses. In a fight: Z cuts, X is the heavy blow, C the shield, Space the roll.
  • PhoneTurn it sideways. Your left thumb gets a stick, your right thumb A, B, X and Y. Tap a place to walk there. Sound starts at your first tap.
  • GamepadPlug one in and press any button. The stick walks, A talks and cuts, X is the heavy blow, B the shield, Y the roll.
  • Back hereUse your browser's back button, or press the back gesture on a phone.

Going straight to a place from a link: #camp3d #troy_night3d #ismaros_world #lotus3d #goat3d #cyclops_world. Anything after an & goes to the place as its settings, for example #camp3d&q=low.
